source.test: composer.collection.tree-interactions keeps tree intent and layout independent

steps.title: 打开Composer的Collection工具栏 / Open the Composer Collection toolbar
新建根目录并进入名称编辑 / Create a root folder and edit its name
保存第一级目录名称 / Save the first-level folder name
在第一级目录菜单中找到New folder / Locate New folder in the first-level folder menu
保存第二级目录名称 / Save the second-level folder name
在第二级目录菜单中找到New folder / Locate New folder in the second-level folder menu
通过toolbar与目录菜单连续创建三级目录，每次都走同一行内rename流程。 / Create three folder levels through the toolbar and folder menus, using the same inline rename flow.
第三级菜单禁用New folder，仍可New request / The third-level menu disables New folder but permits New request
在第三级目录中新建Untitled请求 / Create an Untitled request in the third-level folder
填写第三级目录中请求的URL，尚未发送 / Enter the nested request URL before sending
打开请求菜单，选择Rename / Open the request menu and locate Rename
填写请求新名称，尚未提交 / Enter the new request name before committing it
在节流保存触发前立即卸载Composer，返回后必须由Core恢复最新rename与URL。 / Unmount Composer before the debounce fires; remount must restore the latest rename and URL from Core.
选择目录作为新建落点，保留当前请求 / Select the creation folder while retaining the active request
目录选择和空白取消只改变新建落点，不得关闭或替换当前request。 / Folder selection and whitespace clearing change only the creation target, never the active request.
拖动Collection splitter只改变左栏宽度，树与当前文档仍保持可用。 / Drag the Collection splitter to change only layout while preserving the tree and active document.
填写自有认证接口地址，尚未发送 / Enter the owned authentication endpoint before sending
None请求由自有认证服务返回401 / The owned authentication service rejects a None request
打开请求Auth设置 / Open request authentication settings
选择Auth basic，尚未重新发送 / Select Auth basic before sending again
填写公开Basic示例用户名 / Enter the public Basic example username
填完公开Basic示例，尚未发送 / Complete the public Basic example before sending
Basic仅使用公开本机示例并核对200 / Verify Basic with public loopback-only example values
选择Auth bearer，尚未重新发送 / Select Auth bearer before sending again
填写公开Bearer示例，尚未发送 / Enter the public Bearer example before sending
切换Bearer并核对真实Authorization / Switch to Bearer and verify the actual Authorization
选择Auth none，尚未重新发送 / Select Auth none before sending again
切回None后不再发送自动认证字段 / Switching to None removes the derived authentication header
Auth None下打开Headers / Open Headers with Auth None
填写显式Authorization Header名称 / Enter the explicit Authorization header name
填写公开Authorization示例值，尚未添加 / Enter the public Authorization example before adding the row
添加显式Authorization，尚未发送 / Add the explicit Authorization header before sending
None仍保留用户显式添加的Header / None retains an explicitly authored header
删除显式Authorization，尚未重新发送 / Delete the explicit Authorization header before resending
删除显式Authorization后重新核对401 / Verify 401 after deleting the explicit Authorization
选择POST方法 / Select the POST method
填写Header名称x-e2e-current / Enter the x-e2e-current header name
填写x-e2e-current的值，尚未添加 / Enter the x-e2e-current value before adding the row
添加并启用x-e2e-current / Add and enable x-e2e-current
添加并启用Content-Type / Add and enable Content-Type
打开尚未添加行的Query表格 / Open Query before adding rows
填写Query名称，准备添加table / Enter the Query name for table
填写Query值table / Enter the Query value table
添加同名Query行entry=table / Add the entry=table Query row
填写Query名称，准备添加again / Enter the Query name for again
填写Query值again / Enter the Query value again
添加同名Query行entry=again / Add the entry=again Query row
更新请求URL，尚未发送 / Update the request URL before sending
设置json请求的Content-Type / Set Content-Type for the json request
打开Body，准备切换为json / Open Body before selecting json
选择json正文类型，尚未输入 / Select the json body type before entering its content
输入json正文，尚未Format或Send / Enter the json body before Format or Send
Format后的JSON，尚未发送 / Inspect formatted JSON before sending
发送json并核对重复Query与完整正文 / Send json and verify duplicate Query values and complete body bytes
更新请求URL，尚未发送 / Update the request URL before sending
设置text请求的Content-Type / Set Content-Type for the text request
选择text正文类型，尚未输入 / Select the text body type before entering its content
输入text正文，尚未Format或Send / Enter the text body before Format or Send
发送text并核对重复Query与完整正文 / Send text and verify duplicate Query values and complete body bytes
更新请求URL，尚未发送 / Update the request URL before sending
设置form请求的Content-Type / Set Content-Type for the form request
选择form正文类型，尚未输入 / Select the form body type before entering its content
填写Form字段name，尚未添加 / Enter the name Form field before adding it
添加Form字段name / Add the name Form field
填写Form字段ready，尚未添加 / Enter the ready Form field before adding it
添加Form字段ready / Add the ready Form field
发送form并核对重复Query与完整正文 / Send form and verify duplicate Query values and complete body bytes
重发前查看当前Query行 / Inspect the current Query rows before replay
将当前Query值改为current / Change the current Query value to current
设置本次重发使用的Headers / Set the Headers used by the next replay
输入本次重发正文Hello replay / Enter Hello replay for the next send
选择历史记录前的方法与当前正文 / Inspect the method and current body before choosing history
打开Recent sends菜单 / Open the Recent sends menu
恢复历史POST与已组合URL，保留当前正文且尚未重发 / Restore the historical POST and composed URL without sending or replacing the current body
Recent sends重发使用当前字段与正文 / Recent sends replay uses the current fields and body
停用Query行但保留名称和值 / Disable a Query row while retaining its name and value
停用Query行但保留名称和值 / Disable a Query row while retaining its name and value
停用Header行但保留其值 / Disable the Header row while retaining its value
选择Body None，尚未发送 / Select Body None before sending
更新请求URL，尚未发送 / Update the request URL before sending
停用的字段和Body None均不发送 / Disabled fields and Body None are not sent
删除第1条Query行 / Delete Query row 1
删除第2条Query行 / Delete Query row 2
删除自定义Header，保留Content-Type / Delete the custom Header while retaining Content-Type
删除Content-Type后查看空Headers表格 / Inspect the empty Headers table after deleting Content-Type
填写同目录第二条请求的独立URL / Enter a separate URL for the sibling request
切回第一条请求，恢复它自己的URL / Switch to the first request and recover its own URL
切换同目录请求并保留各自内容 / Switch sibling requests while preserving their content
重命名目录，尚未调整请求顺序 / Rename the folder before reordering its requests
重命名目录并调整请求顺序 / Rename the folder and reorder its requests
打开第二条请求的Delete菜单项 / Locate Delete in the sibling request menu
删除同级请求并保留原请求 / Delete the sibling while retaining the original request
打开目录的Delete菜单项 / Locate Delete in the folder menu
删除目录及其请求后完成自动保存 / Autosave after deleting the folder and its requests
